method: Same-agent English/Marathi close reading; exact structural comparison; replay of both separation lemmas; and direct checking of the corrected H symbol through the two contraposition steps. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Sentence separation, inseparable sentence sets, conservative addition of fresh constants and preservation of inseparability when an existential witness is added.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: An interpolant C for A and B separates A from not-B because C follows from A while not-C follows from not-B. More generally, C separates sentence sets Gamma and Delta exactly when Gamma entails C and Delta entails not-C; without such a sentence the sets are inseparable. The figure depicts the corresponding model-class inclusions.
samples.checks: Contraposition is used in the correct direction, the two-set definition retains both entailments, and the translated caption says that C separates Gamma and Delta.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Adding infinitely many fresh constants to the common language cannot make an inseparable pair separable. If a separator with fresh constants existed, compactness gives finite Gamma-zero and Delta-zero; replacing the fresh constant by a variable, generalizing and contraposing produces a separator already in the old language.
samples.checks: The finite conjunctions G and H, universal closure and two contraposition steps were followed formula by formula. The frozen delta typo was corrected to H under OLFOL-041, which makes the following H-entailment valid.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: If Gamma together with an existential sentence is inseparable from Delta, adjoining a fresh witness instance preserves inseparability. A purported separator either omits the fresh constant, so satisfiability survives the witness expansion, or contains it, in which case deduction and generalization yield an old-language existential separator, contradicting the hypothesis.
samples.checks: Both cases, the freshness conditions, witness substitution, deduction step, universal conditional and final existential separator retain the source direction and scope.

limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
